title: Android 10 Notification Arrow
body:
![XdripArrowBug](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4053079/65045100-7aafb700-d95e-11e9-8d86-20c47497e0a9.jpg)

Since upgrading to Android 10 on a Pixel 3, the arrows that use to point to 0, 45, 90, 135 and 180 degrees now seem to be flipped so they point to 225 (as shown in this picture, 270 etc. Tried restarting a couple of times without a change.

Running the beta channel 14a03a7-2019.05.18 at the moment.

I have the same issue on a Google Pixel 2 XL, running 14a03a7-2019.05.18. The arrow in the app displays just fine. If I remember right, the arrow in the browser while viewing Nightscout also displays just fine. If I notice any other arrows displaying it incorrectly, I'll note it here.
Sorry for not updating, running 17cbcf0 - 2021.03.08 on the same Pixel 3 Android 11 this is not happening for me anymore.
I wonder what caused this.  I used a virtual device in Android Studio and installed the version you reported in your first post in this thread.  But, I could not recreate the issue.

@duncanbarnes 
I wonder if you may be willing to help us with this by installing that old version over your current version of xDrip and see if the problem returns.  If you are, please don't uninstall.  Just install over.

Sure, may be 24 hours or so before I get a chance, am working GMT+8 at the moment and don't get much time off but will do so as soon as I get a chance. Bear in mind the Android update that has occured since that version but am happy to help if I can.

@Navid200 I must apologise for not following up on this sooner. I did an initial downgrade just over a month ago without success but had not found time to look again until now I'm back in the UK. Downgrading to 14a03a7 from 17cbcf0 no longer appears to work on a Pixel 3 (now on Android 11). xDrip connects to the MiaoMiao2 but never collects any data. Looking at the logs I get "onServicesDiscovered: xdrip service 0000ffe0-0000-1000-8000-00805f9b34fb not found" and nothing else although xDrip status shows a valid connection to the MiaoMiao.

@duncanbarnes Obviously, people experienced this problem.
But, since then, a lot has changed, mainly, xDrip.
If we cannot recreate the problem, I suggest we close the issue.  But, I remember.  If this is experienced again in the future, I will reopen.  
What do you think?
@Navid200 Yes, I was going to suggest that, have closed it.
